pairs.question: Quare non faeces bibisti?
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange: the soldier Burburus, having lost the drinking contest, genuinely asks Firmus (interrogative 'quare') why he did not drink the dregs; Firmus answers. Stripped framing 'et cum ei Burburus diceret:' before the question and 'respondit ille:' after it; normalized capitalization of 'quare' and 'stulte'. No editorial brackets in this span. Both utterances quoted verbatim and complete.
